fresh_blocks.acceptance: first complete batch where each named incidence pattern is structurally present on at least one sampled coordinate in at least six of eight blocks

structural_patterns.encoding: four-bit cue incidence, integer bit c is cue slot c, displayed most-significant bit first
structural_patterns.source: frozen 64 selected coordinates in each of nine substrate by two side cells

task.schedule_generator: existing deterministic SplitMix64 qualification schedule procedure
task.label_balance: two positive and two negative labels, shuffled deterministically

estimator.minibatch_order: frozen global row order, contiguous slices, no shuffle

primary_reporting: paired pooled and blockwise IPW-balanced error_D_minus_error_C
pooled, blockwise, and pattern-conditioned Psi_C, Psi_D, and DeltaPsi_D_minus_C
pattern-conditioned balanced error and signed margins for 0011, 0101, 0001, 0100
per-Psi leverage ESS and top 1, 5, and 20 percent leverage shares
complete block by pattern table, including empty cells
replication_rule: cross-block 0011 support requires DeltaPsi_D_minus_C(0011) > 0 in at least six of the eight structurally supported blocks
inference_boundary: qualification replication only; no confirmatory population claim
truth_firewall: write and hash all held-out prediction streams, then pass independent integrity validation before joining held-out truth
run4_policy: closed archaeology; no additional outcome slicing and no RUN4 data used for task or seed selection
